_comment: Full-featured fixture exercising camera pinning, markers-off mode, scoring bands, and button label overrides. Uses the bundled Khronos Box placeholder (CC BY 4.0) because it is the only GLB that ships with the activity; authors swap model.src for real geometry (e.g. an anatomy model) in production.
title: Identify the faces of the cube (no markers)
prompt: Markers are hidden in this activity. Use the named list below the viewport to pick the top face of the cube.

hotspots.label: Top face
hotspots.feedback: Correct. The top face of the cube sits at +Y in the model's local space.

hotspots.label: Bottom face
hotspots.feedback: That is the bottom face. The prompt asked for the top.

hotspots.label: Front face
hotspots.feedback: That is the front face (+Z). The prompt asked for the top.

hotspots.label: Right face
hotspots.feedback: That is the right face (+X). The prompt asked for the top.

bands.message: Orbit the cube and try the list again.
